# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

# Improving the lives of the people we touch

Convatec is a global medical products and technologies company focused on therapies for the
management of chronic conditions, leading in advanced wound care, stoma care, continence and
critical care, and infusion devices.
[ Learn about us ][223]

## Forever Caring

Living with a condition, no matter how long or short it may be, is a journey. One that will be
different for everyone. That can feel unpredictable and unfair. And at times even life changing. But
we believe it never needs to be YOU changing. That you deserve better, holistic care. So, you can
keep being you.

# Improving the lives of the people we touch

Convatec is a global medical products and technologies company focused on therapies for the
management of chronic conditions, leading in advanced wound care, stoma care, continence and
critical care, and infusion devices.

## Forever Caring

Living with a condition, no matter how long or short it may be, is a journey. One that will be
different for everyone. That can feel unpredictable and unfair. And at times even life changing. But
we believe it never needs to be YOU changing. That you deserve better, holistic care. So, you can
keep being you.

# Altrix Precision Temperature Management

Effective patient warming and cooling are crucial for achieving positive health outcomes. **Altrix**
offers a superior solution for temperature management with precision, versatility, and speed—all
within one easy-to-use system suitable for all clinical setting.

[Talk With A Rep][6]
[
][7]

# One machine.
# `One System.`

### Three water circuits

Simple, self-sealing hose ports eliminate water spillage and maximize performance, efficiency, and
speed to target temperature. All three water circuits can be individually monitored for ease of use.

### Removable water reservoir

Therapy setup is simple and easy, and allows for uninterrupted temperature management while adding
or refilling water with the translucent, removable water reservoir

### Ease of mobility

Altrix was designed with ergonomic support in mind. This usability, alongside its proven durable
features, results in one machine that can easily be maneuvered throughout the entire hospital.

[Talk With A Rep][8]

# One Machine.
# ‍`Universal Temperature Management.`

# Simple.

### Patient graphs

Patient graphs provide information about the patient, target, and water temperature as well as power
levels in order to help effectively analyze treatment.

### Situational help

Situational help offers assistance and guidance in the case of an alarm in order to properly educate
users as to the cause of the alert and how to correct the situation.

### **Fast, easily prompted therapy**

The user-friendly graphic interface makes it easy to initiate patient therapy with just a few simple
taps of the finger. These prompts ensure easy setup, especially during highly critical, low
frequency situations.

# Smart.

### **No aerosolization of bacteria**

Since 2015, the FDA issued three safety communications about a potential association between patient
infections and water-based heater-cooler devices. Nontuberculous mycobacteria (NTM) might have
aerosolized into the operating room from the devices and caused serious illness and death of
patients.^{1-4}  Rigorous tests performed by an independent laboratory verified that Altrix, when
used and maintained according to manufacturer instructions, does not aerosolize microbes from its
water system.

### **Advanced skin protection**

- Non-gel-adhesive, will not stick to a patient’s skin potentially removing skin upon wrap removal,
or leaving adhesive on a patient’s skin. Our wraps are soft non-woven fabric to promote skin
integrity.
- Insulated to prevent condensation, reducing wetness near patient’s skin which is a skin integrity
risk.

### **Fast, easily prompted therapy**

Accuracy in therapy management is critical, which is why Altrix measures patient temperatures every
1.3 seconds. This rapid responsiveness uses thousands of power settings to achieve steady state
patient control with ± 0.1° C.*

# Efficient.

### **Universal temperature management**

Simplicity is integral in highly critical, low frequency situations. The simple, versatile design of
Altrix ensures it can be easily used in all clinical settings, for both traditional and critical
applications.

### **Altrix Wraps**

The Altrix wraps were designed with the patient and caregiver in mind. The non-invasive and
non-adhesive wraps provide increased surface area contact, helping to reduce air gaps that can occur
between surface cooling and warming devices and patients’ skin.

### **Maximum efficiency**

Fast therapy management means Altrix can reach water target temperatures 50% faster, and patient
target temperatures 40% faster than Medi-Therm.*

*Comparative performance claims are in reference to Medi-Therm III MTA7900 using a simulated
patient.

## Spotlight on Education

**36.4 CH, 36.4 AEU, 9.7 IPCH**

Designed for new and returning labor and delivery nurses who participate in Cesarean section
procedures, this hybrid course provides the necessary clinical foundation for safe surgical
practice.

This online facility subscription provides access to the most current AORN Guidelines for
Perioperative Practice and comes with a complete set of implementation tools and resources to
empower your team to apply standardized techniques facility-wide.

**39.8 CH, 39.8 AEU, 10.8 IPCH**

Periop 101 OR is an online course that prepares novice nurses for the operating room. This OR nurse
training is part of the full Periop 101 Program.

**18.5 CH, 18.5 AEU**

This comprehensive ASC administrator course helps new ambulatory surgery leaders to hit the ground
running. It helps administrators pinpoint and prioritize the most crucial duties in their first year
and provides supporting education to help you tackle these responsibilities like an experienced

# Saving Lives.
# Together.

On the front lines of critical care, everything matters. Lives depend upon us—all of us bringing our
best. Our innovative medical devices help you deliver. Belmont’s solutions blend technical
inspiration with an uncompromising quality standard. Because earning your trust is the only option.

When lives are in your hands, reach for Belmont.

## At our best when it matters most.

In developing and refining our leading fluid warming and temperature regulation devices, we strive
to innovate advanced capabilities and patient safety features that give you the power and precision
to change the course of critical outcomes.
* [ BLOOD & FLUID WARMING ][31]
* [ TEMPERATURE MANAGEMENT ][32]
* [ HYPERTHERMIC LAVAGE ][33]

BLOOD & FLUID WARMING

### The Belmont^{®} Rapid Infuser RI-2

Trusted in the most extreme situations for more than 20 years, The Belmont® Rapid Infuser delivers
rapid, reliable, and bubble-free delivery of life-saving warmed blood and fluid at the touch of a
button.
* Precise control of fluid delivery (at rates from 2.5 to 1000 ml per minute)
* Precise, high-speed warming
* Automatic air detection and removal
* Intuitive touchscreen display
* Aluminum-free disposables

[LEARN MORE][34]
BLOOD & FLUID WARMING

### buddy lite^{®}

Portable blood and fluid warming—anytime, anywhere—in a remarkably compact, lightweight package,
buddy lite^{®} is used globally by clinicians to help prevent hypothermia during fluid
administration.
* Easy to use
* Close-to-patient warming
* Battery or AC powered
* Military tested and approved
* Aluminum-free disposable

[LEARN MORE][35]
BLOOD & FLUID WARMING

### BloodNav^{™}

MTP Performance Improvement & Automatic Documentation Tool
* Rapidly tracks blood products across all locations
* Calculates ratios to support balanced transfusion goals
* Displays customizable MTP performance improvement prompts
* Provides live web dashboard for blood bank
* Streamlines documentation & integrates with EMRs

[LEARN MORE][36]
BLOOD & FLUID WARMING

### Burn Navigator^{®}

Evidence-based fluid management for severely burned adults and children
* Unique resuscitation graphs
* 24-hour volume projections
* Non-responder detection and alerts
* Customizable protocols
* Inhalation injury guidelines
* EMR connectivity

[LEARN MORE][37]
TEMPERATURE MANAGEMENT

### Allon^{®}

Safe, simple, and effective, this non-invasive system maintains patient body temperature throughout
all stages of the perioperative continuum. Allon’s algorithm-driven heat pump circulates water
through the ThermoWrap^{®} disposable patient garment.
* Consistent body temperature control
* Simple, easy-to-use touch-screen interface
* Real-time monitoring and graphical display
* Full range of sizes and configurations

 

[LEARN MORE][38]
TEMPERATURE MANAGEMENT

### CritiCool^{®}

Maintaining pre-set, targeted body temperature as determined by a physician, this safe, and
effective system is composed of two elements, the CritiCool device and the CureWrap^{®}.
* Consistent body temperature control
* Simple, easy to use and quick set up
* Real-time monitoring and graphical touch-screen display
* Flexibility and versatility with one-piece body-shaped garments

[LEARN MORE][39]
HYPERTHERMIC LAVAGE

### Hyperthermia Pump^{™}

The Hyperthermia Pump raises the temperature of a patient’s thoracic or peritoneal cavity to the
desired target temperature by continuously lavaging it with warmed sterile solution.
* Precise temperature control
* High-efficiency electromagnetic induction warmer
* Automatic air removal
* Easy-to-use touchscreen
* Aluminum-free disposables

[LEARN MORE][40]

your own people expect the best from you. Belmont solutions blend technical inspiration with
uncompromising quality to give your clinicians added power to affect the course of medical events.
That’s the goal we all share.

# EM-MED Temperature Management Products

Exact temperature makes a big difference.

**We are specialists in patient temperature management**. In our offer you will find a range of
devices that enable reaching and accurately maintaining the required patient temperature.

[produkty banner]

## [EmTherm®
## warming cabinets][10]

[ [emtherm] ][11]

## [TrueCool®
## therapeutic hypothermia TTM][12]

[ [truecool] ][13]

At **EM-MED**, we design and deliver advanced [**therapeutic hypothermia devices**][14] and [**IV
fluid warmers**][15] that help hospitals maintain precise patient temperature control in critical
care settings. Our smart temperature management systems support optimal outcomes in surgery,
intensive care, and emergency medicine.

Our **IV fluid warming cabinets** safely and efficiently heat intravenous fluids, irrigation
solutions, and medical blankets, ensuring every patient receives warm, ready-to-use materials during
procedures. The **TrueCool® Therapeutic Hypothermia Device** provides rapid cooling, precise
temperature regulation, and safe, controlled rewarming for patients requiring targeted temperature
management after cardiac arrest or neurological injury.

With over **30 years of experience** and trusted by hospitals in **more than 30 countries**, EM-MED
delivers **certified, reliable, and user-friendly temperature management solutions** designed for
modern healthcare environments.

Choose EM-MED’s innovative **therapeutic hypothermia devices** and **IV fluid warmers** to enhance
patient safety, reduce complications, and support better clinical outcomes across every stage of
care.

# EM-MED Temperature Management Products

Exact temperature makes a big difference.

**We are specialists in patient temperature management**. In our offer you will find a range of
devices that enable reaching and accurately maintaining the required patient temperature.

[produkty banner]

## [EmTherm®
## warming cabinets][10]

[ [emtherm] ][11]

## [TrueCool®
## therapeutic hypothermia TTM][12]

[ [truecool] ][13]

At **EM-MED**, we design and deliver advanced [**therapeutic hypothermia devices**][14] and [**IV
fluid warmers**][15] that help hospitals maintain precise patient temperature control in critical
care settings. Our smart temperature management systems support optimal outcomes in surgery,
intensive care, and emergency medicine.

Our **IV fluid warming cabinets** safely and efficiently heat intravenous fluids, irrigation
solutions, and medical blankets, ensuring every patient receives warm, ready-to-use materials during
procedures. The **TrueCool® Therapeutic Hypothermia Device** provides rapid cooling, precise
temperature regulation, and safe, controlled rewarming for patients requiring targeted temperature
management after cardiac arrest or neurological injury.

With over **30 years of experience** and trusted by hospitals in **more than 30 countries**, EM-MED
delivers **certified, reliable, and user-friendly temperature management solutions** designed for
modern healthcare environments.

Choose EM-MED’s innovative **therapeutic hypothermia devices** and **IV fluid warmers** to enhance
patient safety, reduce complications, and support better clinical outcomes across every stage of
care.

# Full-Stack EV Infrastructure. National Execution.

Energy5 delivers complete EV charging infrastructure solutions — from early-stage planning and
incentive strategy to engineering, construction, and long-term operation.

We don't just install chargers. We design infrastructure that performs in real-world conditions,
aligns with long-term ROI, and scales across portfolios.

[Start Project][6][Partner With Us][7]

What We Do

## EV Charging Infrastructure, Built End-to-End

Energy5 manages the full lifecycle of EV charging projects, eliminating fragmentation and reducing
risk.

### Coordinated Structure

From site evaluation to live operational chargers, every step is handled within one structure. This
reduces delays, simplifies communication, and ensures accountability.

### Incentive Strategy Built-In

EV charging is a financial model. We integrate utility rebates, state funding, and federal
incentives into design, capturing funding without compromising quality.

### National Execution

Execution is where most fail. Supported by Utilities One Power Delivery, we deliver at scale
nationally with experienced crews and utility coordination expertise.

Why Energy5

## Built for the Reality of EV Infrastructure

The EV charging market is shifting from early adoption to large-scale deployment. At this stage,
success is no longer defined by how many chargers are installed — it is defined by whether those
systems perform reliably, generate returns, and integrate effectively with the grid.

#### Actual Usage Patterns

Designing infrastructure based on real-world needs and avoiding overbuilt or underutilized systems.

#### Long-term Economics

Aligning incentives directly with long-term economic performance and ROI.

#### Full Accountability

Delivering projects with complete execution accountability from start to finish.

[EV Charging Installation]

One Principle:

Infrastructure must work beyond installation day.

## Two Pathways to Success

01

### For Businesses

Deploy EV charging infrastructure that aligns with your business objectives. We help property
owners, fleet operators, and real estate developers.
* Evaluate site feasibility and infrastructure requirements
* Reduce capital costs through structured incentive strategies
* Implement systems designed for long-term reliability and ROI

[Start Project][8]
02

### For Partners

Scale EV infrastructure without building internal execution capabilities. We provide turnkey
delivery, white-label construction, and incentive support.
* Charge point operators (CPOs)
* Developers and portfolio owners
* EV networks and infrastructure platforms

[Partner With Us][9]

Execution Powered By

[[Utilities One Group]][10]

This combination of strategy and execution ensures projects are delivered consistently, efficiently,
and at national scale.

“Let's build EV infrastructure that works.”

comfort technologies and fluid systems. Our journey began in the automotive sector, where we
pioneered advanced solutions that have become a standard expectation for consumers. Leveraging this
deep-rooted experience, we continue to invest in next-generation technologies where we develop smart
and reliable solutions that expand what’s possible for both existing and growth markets that we
serve.

Our heating technologies use conductive, convective and radiant methods to deliver advanced thermal
solutions that enhance comfort, safety and performance across industries.

Our cooling and ventilation technologies redefine the industry with intelligent airflow systems that
optimize energy efficiency, comfort and customer needs.

Our pneumatic massage systems are powered by first to market Shape Memory Alloy (SMA) valve
technology and deliver ultra-compact, energy-efficient comfort with scientifically optimized pulse
patterns and lifelike massage experiences for wellness, recovery and relaxation across any
environment.

Our advanced valve systems feature Shape Memory Alloy (SMA) actuation and precision injection
molding, which deliver lightweight, modular and energy-efficient solutions for fuel management,
engine control, braking performance and thermal regulation across conventional, hybrid and electric
vehicles.

###### About Us

## Green Guys Mechanical

A local, family-owned HVAC company serving Rochester and surrounding areas.

Green Guys Mechanical was founded to bring professional, honest geothermal and heat pump expertise
to Rochester. We specialize in cold-climate heating systems for families and homeowners who want to
save money and stay comfortable year-round.



We're a local, family-owned company with 5+ years serving Monroe, Wayne, and Ontario counties across
60+ towns including Rochester, Ontario, Webster, Mendon, Honeoye Falls, Pittsford, Fairport,
Penfield, Victor, Canandaigua, and more.

###### Services

## Heat Pump & Geothermal Solutions for Rochester Homes

Installation, repair, and maintenance for systems that work in extreme cold.

### Geothermal Heat Pump Installation

Stable, efficient heating and cooling using ground temperature. Perfect for homeowners looking for
long-term energy savings and year-round comfort. Our IGSHPA-certified team handles complex
installations.

[ Learn more ][78]

### Air Source Heat Pump Installation

Fast, cost-effective heating and cooling even in sub-zero Rochester winters. Modern cold-climate air
source heat pumps are engineered to perform. Rebate-eligible and efficient.

continue to rise. Sterile processing departments (SPD) and operating rooms (OR) are under constant

performance.

## We are Your UK Normothermia Experts

#### Air-Free

HotDog utilizes a unique conductive fabric called ThermAssure® which emits no waste heat. Forced-air
warming systems contaminate the air of the sterile field when their waste heat carries particles to
the surgical site.

#### Better Warming

Warm from above and below the patient at the same time. HotDog is the only technology with both
blankets and mattresses. This gives it tremendous versatility and effectiveness for many procedures.

#### Cost Effective

Implement HotDog with no up-front costs and immediate cost savings. Decrease your cost of care.
Normothermic patients have better outcomes which lead to shorter hospital stays and faster operating
room turnover rates.

## What is HotDog?

HotDog Patient Warming is an air-free, water-free, perioperative temperature management system. A
central temperature management controller sends low-voltage current to up to 5 warming devices.
Efficient warming is then delivered by a flexible, lightweight conductive polymer fabric inside of
HotDog blankets and mattresses. This fabric performs resistive warming, which is much safer than
other warming systems. It’s the only patient warming system that warms the patient from above and
below simultaneously. This results in a uniquely versatile, less expensive, and more effective
warming solution before, during, and after surgery.

## Why Should You Use Air-Free Patient Warming?

#### Managing the Risks of Waste Heat in the Operating Theatre

“Recent research has revealed that even if smoke evacuation is utilised, surgeons, anesthetists and
the entire OR staff are still at risk of inhaling the viruses and carcinogens contained in surgical
smoke. Why is this the case? The culprit is rising waste heat from commonly used hot-air
patient-warming devices.”

## Patient Warming UK – Sustainability Policy

At Patient Warming UK, sustainability is not just a commitment; it’s our guiding principle. We
prioritise environmental responsibility by integrating sustainable practices into every aspect of
our operations. From sourcing materials with minimal ecological impact to implementing
energy-efficient manufacturing processes, we strive to minimise our carbon footprint. Moreover, we
prioritise the well-being of our communities by supporting local initiatives and fostering a culture
of environmental stewardship among our employees. Through continuous innovation and collaboration,
we aim to create products that promote health, preserve resources, and contribute to a more
sustainable future for generations to come.

## Every single person at Thetford makes the difference

While we come from different backgrounds and cultures, we all have and share the same values in the
way we work with each other.

We do not just make products, we create them. Every step we make together with our colleagues. We
imagine, create, develop, produce, transport and support.

We work together with thinkers and with doers, so we can act global, think local and do what we
love.

[toss ins 16ct aqua kem resized]

### Blue is back!

One of our most popular RV holding tank treatments, Aqua-Kem Toss-Ins®, has returned. Perfect for
RVs and marine applications, the Bronopol-based formula liquefies waste, breaks down tissue, and
delivers superior odor control.

[ Aqua-Kem Toss-Ins® ][67]
[Thetford Aqua Magic VI Homepage Banner]

### Constantly improving RV sanitation

Introducing the Aqua-Magic® VI, a lightweight RV toilet designed to bring the comfort of a home
toilet to your travels, along with easy cleaning and low maintenance.

[ Aqua-Magic® VI ][68]
[Titan Tote 4 wheel Airstream Homepage Banner]

### Changing the standards

At Thetford®, we never stop looking for ways to improve and break patterns. Titan® portable totes
have the industry’s lowest fill height. This makes allows easy emptying for even the lowest RV waste
valves.

[ Portable totes ][69]

### Operating room

In the operating room, where precision and reliability are paramount, our solutions bring effortless
improvements in care. Our solutions are designed to support surgical teams, with warming devices and
bronchoscopes that ensure patient stability and enhance procedural safety, helping you achieve the
best outcomes in every surgery.

### Intensive care unit

Our integrated solutions include advanced temperature management systems, precise fluid and blood
warming devices, and single-use bronchoscopes, all designed to enhance patient care. These solutions
support ICU teams in delivering optimal treatment, improving outcomes, and supporting patient safety
in critical moments.

### Emergency department

In the emergency room, rapid and accurate care is crucial. Patient warming technology ensures that
interventions are delivered at optimal temperatures, preventing hypothermia and improving patient
outcomes. This vital solution supports emergency teams by enhancing the efficiency and safety of
critical interventions, ultimately helping to save lives when every second counts.

### Bronchoscopy

Broncoflex offers advanced solutions for bronchoscopy with its innovative single-use bronchoscopes.
Designed for precision and ease of use, Broncoflex single use bronchoscopes provide high-quality
visualization and minimize the risk of cross-contamination. Ideal for both diagnostic and
therapeutic procedures, these reliable endoscopes enhance patient safety and efficiency in critical
care and surgical settings.

### Urology

In urology, using warmed irrigation fluid enhances patient comfort and maintains normothermia which
reduces the risk of hypothermia during procedures like TURP or cystoscopy. This solution not only
improves patient safety but also ensures smoother, more efficient procedures, especially late in the
list, leading to better overall results in urological care.

# Innovation

Solu tions

Our solutions

## How can we help you?

### Operating room

In the operating room, where precision and reliability are paramount, our solutions bring effortless
improvements in care. Our solutions are designed to support surgical teams, with warming devices and
bronchoscopes that ensure patient stability and enhance procedural safety, helping you achieve the
best outcomes in every surgery.

[ Read more ][38]
[ Read more ][39]

### Intensive care unit

Our integrated solutions include advanced temperature management systems, precise fluid and blood
warming devices, and single-use bronchoscopes, all designed to enhance patient care. These solutions
support ICU teams in delivering optimal treatment, improving outcomes, and supporting patient safety
in critical moments.

[ Read more ][40]
[ Read more ][41]

### Emergency department

In the emergency room, rapid and accurate care is crucial. Patient warming technology ensures that
interventions are delivered at optimal temperatures, preventing hypothermia and improving patient
outcomes. This vital solution supports emergency teams by enhancing the efficiency and safety of
critical interventions, ultimately helping to save lives when every second counts.

[ Read more ][42]
[ Read more ][43]

### Bronchoscopy

Broncoflex offers advanced solutions for bronchoscopy with its innovative single-use bronchoscopes.
Designed for precision and ease of use, Broncoflex single use bronchoscopes provide high-quality
visualization and minimize the risk of cross-contamination. Ideal for both diagnostic and
therapeutic procedures, these reliable endoscopes enhance patient safety and efficiency in critical
care and surgical settings.

[ Read more ][44]
[ Read more ][45]

### Urology

In urology, using warmed irrigation fluid enhances patient comfort and maintains normothermia which
reduces the risk of hypothermia during procedures like TURP or cystoscopy. This solution not only
improves patient safety but also ensures smoother, more efficient procedures, especially late in the
list, leading to better overall results in urological care.

[ Read more ][46]
[ Read more ][47]
In the spotlight

## Broncoflex^{®} 5.6/3.0 XFlo

XFlo is the latest addition to the Broncoflex^{®} range, designed with the largest working channel
for its outer diameter to deliver best-in-class suction performance. Tailored to meet the
requirements of pulmonologists, intensivists and anesthesiologists, XFlo combines superior
ergonomics with high efficiency for both diagnostic and therapeutic procedures. Its single-use
design supports infection control by reducing cross-contamination risks while streamlining hospital
workflows and logistics through guaranteed sterility and ease of use.

[ Read more ][48] [ Request a trial ][49]

## patient care

Our mission is to drive innovation by creating evidence-based solutions that empower healthcare
professionals to improve patient outcomes. With a bold vision of touching the lives of 25 million
patients annually, we aim to disrupt the healthcare market through agility, integrity, and
reliability. Our commitment to continuous improvement ensures that we not only meet but exceed the
expectations of our partners, patients, and stakeholders, fostering a healthier, more sustainable
future for all.

### About

**Zoom Earth** is an interactive weather map of the world.

Explore the current weather and detailed forecasts for your location with stunning, interactive maps
showing rain, wind, temperature, pressure, and more.

With **Zoom Earth** you can track the development of hurricanes and storms, monitor wildfires and
smoke, and stay aware of the latest conditions by viewing satellite imagery and rain radar updated
in near real time.

#### Mobile App

[[App]][1] [[QR]][2]

Download the [**Zoom Earth**][3] app!

**Scan the QR code** with the camera on your mobile device to get the **Zoom Earth** app.

Available on the [App Store][4] for iPhone and iPad, and on [Google Play][5] for Android.

#### Data Sources

Weather forecasts are continually updated with the latest global model data from DWD [ICON][6] and
NOAA/NCEP/NWS [GFS][7].

Radar data is processed in real time from many meteorological [sources][8] around the world.

Live satellite imagery is provided by [NOAA GOES][9], [EUMETSAT Meteosat][10], and [JMA
Himawari][11] geostationary satellites.

HD satellite images are updated twice a day from NASA polar-orbiting satellites [Aqua][12] and
[Terra][13], using services from [GIBS][14], part of [EOSDIS][15].

Tropical system tracks are generated using the latest data from [NHC][16], [JTWC][17], [NRL][18],
and [IBTrACS][19].

Active fire data is compiled from many sources, including [NIFC][20], [CIFFC][21], Australian fire
agencies, [Copernicus EMS][22], and [GDACS][23].

The heat spots overlay shows points of very high temperature detected by satellite. Detections are
updated daily, not live, with data from NASA LANCE [FIRMS][24].

Map labels © [OpenStreetMap][25] contributors.

### Heat Spots

Heat spots are **not live!** Detections are updated *daily* and are delayed by many hours.

Red spots show the *approximate* locations of very high temperature detected by satellite. These
spots may be from fire or other sources of heat such as *hot smoke* or *agriculture*.

Clouds may prevent the detection of heat.

**Do not** use for the preservation of life or property! Detections have limited accuracy. Always
refer to local authorities for the latest information.

### About

**Zoom Earth** is an interactive weather map of the world.

Explore the current weather and detailed forecasts for your location with stunning, interactive maps
showing rain, wind, temperature, pressure, and more.

With **Zoom Earth** you can track the development of hurricanes and storms, monitor wildfires and
smoke, and stay aware of the latest conditions by viewing satellite imagery and rain radar updated
in near real time.

#### Mobile App

[[App]][1] [[QR]][2]

Download the [**Zoom Earth**][3] app!

**Scan the QR code** with the camera on your mobile device to get the **Zoom Earth** app.

Available on the [App Store][4] for iPhone and iPad, and on [Google Play][5] for Android.

#### Data Sources

Weather forecasts are continually updated with the latest global model data from DWD [ICON][6] and
NOAA/NCEP/NWS [GFS][7].

Radar data is processed in real time from many meteorological [sources][8] around the world.

Live satellite imagery is provided by [NOAA GOES][9], [EUMETSAT Meteosat][10], and [JMA
Himawari][11] geostationary satellites.

HD satellite images are updated twice a day from NASA polar-orbiting satellites [Aqua][12] and
[Terra][13], using services from [GIBS][14], part of [EOSDIS][15].

Tropical system tracks are generated using the latest data from [NHC][16], [JTWC][17], [NRL][18],
and [IBTrACS][19].

Active fire data is compiled from many sources, including [NIFC][20], [CIFFC][21], Australian fire
agencies, [Copernicus EMS][22], and [GDACS][23].

The heat spots overlay shows points of very high temperature detected by satellite. Detections are
updated daily, not live, with data from NASA LANCE [FIRMS][24].

### Heat Spots

Heat spots are **not live!** Detections are updated *daily* and are delayed by many hours.

Red spots show the *approximate* locations of very high temperature detected by satellite. These
spots may be from fire or other sources of heat such as *hot smoke* or *agriculture*.

Clouds may prevent the detection of heat.

**Do not** use for the preservation of life or property! Detections have limited accuracy. Always
refer to local authorities for the latest information.
